question: Tỷ trọng chi phí của từng danh mục sản phẩm trong mỗi khu vực
text_for_embedding: Tỷ trọng chi phí của từng danh mục sản phẩm trong mỗi khu vực

WITH total_cost AS (
    SELECT
        territory_name,
        SUM(base_currency_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_actual_cost
    GROUP BY territory_name
)
SELECT
    f.territory_name,
    f.product_category,
    SUM(f.base_currency_amount) AS cost_value,
    SUM(f.base_currency_amount) / t.total_cost AS cost_share
FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_actual_cost f
JOIN total_cost t
    ON f.territory_name = t.territory_name
GROUP BY
    f.territory_name,
    f.product_category,
    t.total_cost
ORDER BY
    f.territory_name,
    cost_share DESC

question: Tỷ trọng doanh thu theo kênh thu tiền trên tổng doanh thu
text_for_embedding: Tỷ trọng doanh thu theo kênh thu tiền trên tổng doanh thu
code:
WITH total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue_amount) AS total
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_allocated_revenue
)
SELECT
    channel_name,
    SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_value,
    SUM(revenue_amount) / total_revenue.total AS revenue_share
FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_allocated_revenue
CROSS JOIN total_revenue
GROUP BY
    channel_name,
    total_revenue.total
ORDER BY revenue_share DESC

question: Chỉ số entropy tổng hợp của doanh thu kế hoạch và MUST
text_for_embedding: Chỉ số entropy tổng hợp của doanh thu kế hoạch và MUST
code:
WITH seg_rev AS (
    SELECT customer_segment_l1,
           SUM(plan_nice_amount + plan_must_amount) AS revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_revenue_plan
    GROUP BY customer_segment_l1
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
    FROM seg_rev
)
SELECT -SUM((revenue / NULLIF(total,0)) * LN(revenue / NULLIF(total,0))) AS entropy_index
FROM seg_rev
CROSS JOIN total_rev

question: Chỉ số bất bình đẳng doanh thu tổng hợp NICE và MUST
text_for_embedding: Chỉ số bất bình đẳng doanh thu tổng hợp NICE và MUST
code:
WITH seg_rev AS (
    SELECT
        customer_segment_l1,
        SUM(plan_nice_amount + plan_must_amount) AS revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_revenue_plan
    GROUP BY customer_segment_l1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue) AS rnk,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS n,
        SUM(revenue) OVER () AS total
    FROM seg_rev
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM((2 * rnk - n - 1) * revenue) AS DOUBLE) /
    NULLIF(CAST(MAX(n) * MAX(total) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS gini_coefficient
FROM ordered

question: Xác định các phân khúc có shock doanh thu kế hoạch lớn nhất

code:
WITH yearly_seg AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('year', plan_date) AS year,
        customer_segment_l1,
        SUM(plan_nice_amount) AS revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_revenue_plan
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
diff AS (
    SELECT
        customer_segment_l1,
        ABS(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_segment_l1 ORDER BY year)) AS shock
    FROM yearly_seg
)

    MAX(shock) AS max_shock
FROM diff

ORDER BY max_shock DESC

question: Tổng hợp các chỉ số AI-grade cho kế hoạch doanh thu (entropy, gini, momentum)
text_for_embedding: Tổng hợp các chỉ số AI-grade cho kế hoạch doanh thu (entropy, gini, momentum)
code:
WITH seg_rev AS (
    SELECT customer_segment_l1, SUM(plan_nice_amount) AS revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_revenue_plan
    GROUP BY customer_segment_l1
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
    FROM seg_rev
),
entropy AS (
    SELECT -SUM((revenue / NULLIF(total,0)) * LN(revenue / NULLIF(total,0))) AS entropy_index
    FROM seg_rev CROSS JOIN total_rev
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue) AS rnk,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS n,
        SUM(revenue) OVER () AS total
    FROM seg_rev
),
gini AS (
    SELECT
        SUM((2*rnk - n - 1) * revenue) /
        NULLIF(CAST(MAX(n) AS DOUBLE) * MAX(total),0) AS gini_index
    FROM ordered
),
monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', plan_date) AS month, SUM(plan_nice_amount) AS revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_revenue_plan
    GROUP BY 1
),
momentum AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_momentum
    FROM (
        SELECT revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS diff
        FROM monthly_rev
    )
)

SELECT entropy_index, gini_index, avg_momentum
FROM entropy
CROSS JOIN gini
CROSS JOIN momentum

question: Phát hiện tháng có chi phí thực tế bất thường bằng z-score so với doanh thu thu tiền
text_for_embedding: Phát hiện tháng có chi phí thực tế bất thường bằng z-score so với doanh thu thu tiền
code:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', a.report_date) m,
        SUM(a.base_currency_amount) cost,
        SUM(c.revenue_amount) revenue
    FROM hive.bi_silver.finance_actual_cost a
    LEFT JOIN hive.bi_silver.finance_allocated_revenue c
        ON date_trunc('month', a.report_date) = date_trunc('month', c.report_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(cost) avg_cost,
        STDDEV(cost) std_cost
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT
    m,
    cost,
    (cost - avg_cost) / NULLIF(std_cost, 0) AS cost_zscore
FROM monthly
CROSS JOIN stats
ORDER BY ABS((cost - avg_cost) / NULLIF(std_cost, 0)) DESC

        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM hive.bi_silver.crm_deal_interested_products a

    ) AS affinity_ratio

ORDER BY affinity_ratio DESC

question: Tỷ trọng của từng lý do giao dịch trong tổng số lý do là bao nhiêu?
text_for_embedding: Tỷ trọng của từng lý do giao dịch trong tổng số lý do là bao nhiêu?
code:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM hive.bi_silver.crm_deal_reasons
)
SELECT
    r.reason_name,
    COUNT(*) AS reason_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) AS reason_share
FROM hive.bi_silver.crm_deal_reasons r
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY
    r.reason_name,
    t.total_cnt
ORDER BY reason_share DESC

        id,
        COALESCE(won_deals_amount, 0) AS r

question: Chỉ số HHI concentration của answer choices theo câu hỏi

    SELECT question_id, answer_choice_content, COUNT(*) cnt
    FROM hive.bi_silver.cx_sur_question_answer_choices
    GROUP BY question_id, answer_choice_content
), t AS (
    SELECT question_id, SUM(cnt) total
    FROM c
    GROUP BY question_id

    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', collected_date) AS month,

    SELECT survey_id, COUNT(*) cnt
    FROM hive.bi_silver.cx_sur_question_response
    GROUP BY survey_id
), s AS (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) avg_cnt
    FROM t
)

FROM t

        COUNT(*) AS total_emp,
        SUM(

question: Tốc độ tăng trưởng nhiệm vụ tạo theo tháng
text_for_embedding: Tốc độ tăng trưởng ticket tạo theo tháng
code:

           COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM hive.bi_silver.jira_msn

question: Tỷ lệ nhiệm vụ theo task_type trong mỗi project
text_for_embedding: Tỷ lệ ticket theo task_type trong mỗi project
code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT projectkey,
           task_type,
           COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM hive.bi_silver.jira_msn
    GROUP BY projectkey, task_type
), total AS (
    SELECT projectkey,
           SUM(ticket_count) AS total_ticket
    FROM base
    GROUP BY projectkey
)
SELECT b.projectkey,
       b.task_type,
       b.ticket_count,
       CAST(b.ticket_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_ticket, 0) AS ticket_share
FROM base b
JOIN total t ON b.projectkey = t.projectkey

question: Phát hiện assignee có workload cao bất thường so với trung bình
text_for_embedding: Phát hiện assignee có workload cao bất thường so với trung bình
code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT assignee, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM hive.bi_silver.jira_msn
    GROUP BY assignee
), stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(ticket_count) AS avg_ticket
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    b.assignee,
    b.ticket_count,
    CAST(b.ticket_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(s.avg_ticket, 0) AS anomaly_ratio
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY anomaly_ratio DESC

question: Tỷ trọng nhiệm vụ backlog theo phòng ban

WITH base AS (

        department_center,
        COUNT(*) AS backlog_tickets
    FROM hive.bi_silver.jira_msn
    WHERE LOWER(status) IN (LOWER('TODO'), LOWER('IN PROGRESS'))
    GROUP BY department_center

total AS (

        work_group,

FROM base b

ORDER BY anomaly_ratio DESC

question: Tỷ trọng nhiệm vụ MSN theo work_group trong từng project
text_for_embedding: Tỷ trọng ticket MSN theo work_group trong từng project
code:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT m.projectkey,
           t.work_group,
           COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM hive.bi_silver.jira_msn m
    JOIN hive.bi_silver.jira_task_operation t
      ON LOWER(m.key) = LOWER(t.key)
    GROUP BY m.projectkey, t.work_group
),
total AS (
    SELECT projectkey,
           SUM(c) AS total_c
    FROM base
    GROUP BY projectkey
)
SELECT b.projectkey,
       b.work_group,
       CAST(b.c AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_c, 0) AS ticket_share
FROM base b
JOIN total t
  ON LOWER(b.projectkey) = LOWER(t.projectkey)
